gameLocalization.note: Guide aliases are resolved against paired Canto VIII records. First- and second-half Do Not Meddle / You Will Not Meddle and the Deathrite passive/status names are distinguished by record ID. The guide name Extinguish is provisional: its source separately lists Wane and does not establish a separate effect. The raw 113306 skill record supplies the complete name including Tianjiu Star's Blade. Original guide conditions, numeric values, and uncertainty are retained.

stageName.text: Second Hierarch Trial: What Hongyuan Needs Most

lead.text: Keep Hong Lu alive throughout and avoid unnecessary attacks on Zilu. In the second half, win 3 Dialogues with Hong Lu himself to stop the Shield, then beat the finisher to create an opening.

listLead.text: Keep Hong Lu alive throughout and avoid unnecessary attacks on the designated enemy. In the second half, Hong Lu must win 3 Dialogues to stop the Shield, then beat the finisher to create an opening.

statNote.text: The final 8-20 dungeon encounter. Hong Lu is required; his death causes immediate defeat, including during the opening wave. Displayed Offense/Defense Levels account for 35 A Sliver of Anticipation on Qiu, 20 Bloodthirst Suppressed on Zilu, and 5 Concealed Bloodthirst on the Heishou. First- and second-half HP values are 2439 and 3403 respectively; both phases progress at half HP.

skillNote.text: 34 skills listed by user and form. Tiangang Star - Form displays values before the Dialogues Coin Power reduction; with 3 Dialogues, its maximum is 13. The first-half “I Must Push You Further” has no confirmed Offense Level; the repeated Unbreakable Coin I label is provisionally treated as II. Dialogues appears as Uncompromising Imposition for Hong Lu's Lord Identity.

priorities.0.text: Hong Lu's death causes immediate defeat. Bring 7 Sinners and 5 reserves, HP/SP recovery, and powerful skills for Hong Lu.

priorities.1.text: Do not reduce Zilu to 85% HP or lower. Avoid weak one-sided attacks on Qiu while Assist Defense is active.

priorities.2.text: In the second half, Hong Lu must win 3 clashes against “Answer Me, Jia Baoyu”. Heal beforehand for the following mass attack and duel.

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Hong Lu's death immediately ends the fight. Unlike 8-17, sacrificing him does not allow the fight to continue. Prioritize his HP and the resources he needs for Dialogues.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Assist Defense is active on turns with Blinkstep. It intercepts one-sided attacks on Qiu; at 2+, it becomes a powerful Unbreakable Counter. Avoid weak follow-ups and prioritize regular clashes.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: The second-half Shield returns every turn

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Have Hong Lu win against “Answer Me, Jia Baoyu” to reach 3 Dialogues. The Shield falls from 900 to 600 to 300 to none; there is no need to keep breaking it through raw damage alone.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: At 3 Dialogues, everyone except Hong Lu stopped acting

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: This is the scheduled mass attack, followed next turn by a duel with Hong Lu. If he wins against Tiangang Star - Form, the enemy loses 24 Defense Level. Heal everyone and prepare Hong Lu's strong skills beforehand.

units.0.notes.0.text: At 50% HP, immediately ends the turn and enters the second half, before reaching the first-half Stagger threshold.

units.0.notes.1.text: Displayed levels include A Sliver of Anticipation's reductions. This is not a fight against an unmodified Level 90 enemy.

units.1.notes.0.text: Strengthens at 85% HP or lower. At 60% or lower, gains 500 Shield at Turn Start and death prevention. Defeating him is not the objective.

units.1.notes.1.text: Withdraws when Qiu's first half ends. Reappears temporarily in the second half.

units.2.speed.text: 3–5 / 10 for the mass attack after Dialogues

units.2.notes.0.text: Restores full HP and reaches 30 SP on transition. Dialogues reduces the Shield gained each turn.

units.2.notes.1.text: The second half also ends at half HP. Do not budget resources around reducing him to 0.

units.3.notes.0.text: 2 appear in the opening wave. Build SP and resources against them and the 2 Umbrastrikers.

units.3.notes.1.text: Heishou summoned in the second half withdraw after 1 turn. They are not elimination targets like the opening wave.

units.4.notes.0.text: 2 appear in the opening wave. Resist Slash; weak to Blunt.

units.4.notes.1.text: Protect Hong Lu and raise SP through winning clashes.

phases.0.title.text: 7 Sinners and 5 reserves, centered on Hong Lu and healing

phases.0.steps.0.text: Aim for Level 55 and Uptie III or higher. Stock resources for Hong Lu's strong skills and Land of Illusion. His death causes immediate defeat.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Use dungeon healing points and carried-over resources; do not exhaust every powerful skill in the opening wave. Blunt works well against the opening enemies; Gluttony, Lust, and Pride work well against Qiu.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Hong Lu's exclusive support grants +1 Final Power to all skills and lets clash wins heal low-SP allies' SP. His Lord Identity uses different names for the support and Dialogues effects.

phases.1.title.text: Use Blunt damage and build SP

phases.1.steps.0.text: Face 2 Featherstrikers and 2 Umbrastrikers. Win clashes with regular skills to raise everyone's SP, including Hong Lu's.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Focus Blunt damage on one enemy at a time to Stagger and defeat it, limiting opening-wave attrition. Save E.G.O resources for the later Dialogues and healing.

phases.2.title.text: Clash against Qiu and avoid damaging Zilu

phases.2.steps.0.text: Aim to reduce Qiu to 50% HP. Zilu cannot be killed, and reducing him to 85% HP or lower strengthens both enemies. Watch for accidental damage from area attacks.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Win necessary clashes against Zilu so Estimation gives him Bind. Avoid unnecessary follow-ups; spend actions reducing Qiu's HP.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Check Assist Defense on turns with Blinkstep. Weak one-sided attacks on Qiu are intercepted. At 2+ Assist Defense, this becomes a strong Unbreakable Counter; using fewer attacks and more defense or healing is reasonable.

phases.2.steps.3.text: At 50% HP, the turn ends immediately. Heal before crossing the threshold to prepare for the second half.

phases.3.title.text: Hong Lu must win against “Answer Me, Jia Baoyu” 3 times

phases.3.steps.0.text: Qiu returns with 3403 HP and 30 SP, initially gaining 900 Shield every turn. Survive through healing and clashes while progressing Dialogues.

phases.3.steps.1.text: From the second turn of this half, “Answer Me, Jia Baoyu” appears on turns when Heishou temporarily join. It cannot be redirected; Hong Lu must win the clash with his own powerful skill.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Each win grants 1 Dialogues. After 3 wins, future Shield gains stop. Hong Lu's Lord Identity displays this as Uncompromising Imposition; check the number on Hong Lu himself.

phases.3.steps.3.text: The returning Heishou withdraw after 1 turn; do not waste damage trying to kill them. Prioritize Zilu's Assist Defense and Hong Lu's Dialogue clash.

phases.4.title.text: Heal before the mass attack, then win Hong Lu's duel

phases.4.steps.0.text: Next turn brings a Speed 10 Unclashable, unredirectable attack. It targets everyone except Hong Lu; equip defense skills and prepare for the turn to end after the attack.

phases.4.steps.1.text: The following turn brings Tiangang Star - Form against Hong Lu. At 3 Dialogues, Coin Power drops to 2 and its maximum becomes 13. Use his strong skills or E.G.O for a reliable win.

phases.4.steps.2.text: Winning inflicts 24 Defense Level Down on the enemy and halves its damage; that attack cannot Stagger its targets. With 4 Unbreakable Coins and 7 Attack Weight, heal secondary targets beforehand too, and defend against the remaining hits.

phases.4.steps.3.text: Focus the boss once its Shield is gone and Defense Level is reduced, bringing its second-half HP down to 50%.

passives.18.effect.text: Begin the phase retaining half the Rupture, Burn, Sinking, Tremor, and Bleed Potency and Count held at phase transition.

passives.18.response.text: Some statuses carry over at half strength. Do not exhaust powerful skills assuming all first-half buildup remains.

passives.19.effect.text:
At the start of each turn, gain 900 Shield on the body and parts.
- Gain 300 less for every 1 Dialogues on Hong Lu.
At 3+ Dialogues on Hong Lu, gain no further Shield for the rest of the encounter.

passives.19.response.text: The 900 Shield falls by 300 per Dialogues and stops at 3. First progress Dialogues with Hong Lu himself.

passives.20.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.20.response.text: Progress through clashes, Dialogues, and healing rather than relying on changing its Panic type.

passives.21.effect.text: If the target has 3+ Deathrite types, Coin Power +1

passives.21.response.text: The enemy gains +1 Coin Power. Avoid adding Deathrites the target does not yet have.

passives.22.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.22.response.text: Check current predictions rather than assuming low SP persists next turn.

passives.23.effect.text:

When Hong Lu dies, end the encounter.

passives.23.response.text: Displayed levels include the reduction of 5. Hong Lu's death causes defeat even during the opening wave.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Qiu's base Offense and Defense Levels -35. Deal +30% damage with one-sided attacks.

mechanics.0.response.text: Displayed levels include the reduction. Letting attacks through without clashing causes greater damage.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Zilu's base Offense and Defense Levels -20.

mechanics.1.response.text: Distinguish base Level 75 from his current levels.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Heishou base Offense and Defense Levels -5.

mechanics.2.response.text: Use regular skills that win according to current opening-wave predictions.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Redirects one-sided attacks on allies to self and uses a special Guard or Counter. Zilu uses “Swiftfeet Protection” at 1 stack and Cloudsplitting Manifestation at 2+.

mechanics.3.response.text: Avoid weak one-sided attacks on Qiu.

mechanics.4.effect.text: At Turn End, gain 5 Haste next turn and reduce this status by 1.

mechanics.4.response.text: Control Zilu's Speed-difference bonuses with Bind from winning clashes or a different clash handler.

mechanics.5.effect.text: A progression effect Hong Lu gains by winning clashes against the questions. Dialogues heals 5 SP at Turn End and allows full HP recovery at 0 HP as many times as its value. His Lord Identity displays Uncompromising Imposition, which also grants 1 Final Power Up next turn after recovery.

mechanics.5.response.text: Reach 3 to handle the Shield and finisher. Do not neglect Hong Lu's HP by relying on revival.

mechanics.6.effect.text: When Rupture activates at 3+ Bind, reduce this status and raise the Stagger Threshold.

mechanics.6.response.text: Protect the HP of Sinners with both Bind and incoming Rupture damage.

mechanics.7.effect.text: When another Deathrite decreases, this status decreases; at 0, gain 6 Offense Level Down next turn. The same-named passive also makes its holder deal 20% less damage to Qiu.

mechanics.7.response.text: Keep it off key damage dealers and avoid spreading it across the team.

mechanics.8.effect.text: When Rupture activates from an attack by a target with 10+ Speed, reduce this status and increase own Rupture Count.

mechanics.8.response.text: Avoid repeated hits from a fast Zilu; use clashes and healing.

mechanics.9.effect.text: When its inflicter activates Rupture, reduce this status and other Deathrites.

mechanics.9.response.text: Check Deathrite types and Rupture values.

mechanics.10.effect.text: A provisional rendering of the name used in the guide's second-half “Thunderstrike” - Ripple entry. Its dedicated status section instead lists Wane; the source does not establish a separate effect for Extinguish.

mechanics.10.response.text: Do not calculate on the assumption that it is identical to Wane; check the actual status display.

mechanics.11.effect.text: When Rupture activates while Deathrites are present, reduce this status, leading to next-turn Bind.

mechanics.11.response.text: When Rupture and Deathrites accumulate on one Sinner, reconsider next turn's clash assignments.

warnings.0.text: Hong Lu's death causes immediate defeat even with reserves available.

warnings.1.text: Weak one-sided attacks on Qiu while Assist Defense is active trigger Zilu's powerful counterattack.

warnings.2.text: Do not reduce Zilu to 85% HP or lower. He does not need to be defeated and withdraws on entering the second half.

warnings.3.text: The first-half turn ends immediately at 50% HP. Later healing will not resolve.

warnings.4.text: Dialogues progresses only through Hong Lu's own clash wins. The finisher's Defense Level reduction also requires winning that clash.

warnings.5.text: Unbreakable hits remain after winning against the finisher. Stagger prevention applies to that skill's damage; it does not prevent death from Rupture.

preparation.0.text: Bring Hong Lu, healing, 7 Sinners and 5 reserves. Prepare Blunt for the opening wave, and Gluttony, Lust, and Pride for Qiu.

preparation.1.text: Save Hong Lu's E.G.O resources for Dialogues and the duel. Keep checking his HP when Rupture accumulates.

roles.0.reason.text: The mandatory clash handler for progressing Dialogues 3 times and winning the duel.

roles.1.reason.text: Limit attrition from Unbreakable Coins and Rupture, preventing defeat through Hong Lu's death.

roles.2.reason.text: Avoid triggering Assist Defense and spreading Deathrites across the whole team.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)8-20「ジア・チォウ（8-20）」の攻: Jia Qiu (8-20) guide for Limbus Company 8-20. Keep Hong Lu alive throughout and avoid unnecessary attacks on Zilu. In the second half, win 3 Dialogues with Hong Lu himself to stop the Shield, then beat the finisher to create an opening.
